Fairness Coverage Score (FCS, % of 9 FSEs present per artefact: spec, plan, tasks, code); step-wise propagation delta; per-FSE survival rate spec -> code; group fairness of models (AAOD, FDRD, Disparate Impact) for race, sex, age; RQ3 codebook frequencies (feature-space handling, lifecycle timing, custom engineering, rationales)

RQ1: LLM-as-annotator Qwen3.8-27B (OpenRouter, temperature 0) with verbatim-evidence rule checked by script (5 of 1,728 checks flagged); validated on 12 of 48 pipelines by two authors (human-human kappa 0.598; LLM vs human consensus kappa 0.867, 94.07%). RQ2: automatic harness on isolated hold-out; Shapiro-Wilk, Friedman, Wilcoxon + Holm, Cliff's delta. RQ3: AST-based static analyser + joint manual coding of 48 workspaces by two authors (197 quote-anchored evidence items)

Criterion: FSE coverage in artefacts (traceability) and fairness/performance of the model on the hold-out. FCS% in code.py by prompt level minimal/implicit/explicit/operationalized (spec.md under operationalized in brackets). Per-agent RQ2 values not reported (overall only: no significant change). Cost verdict: not measured for all.
- Spec Kit + Claude Code + Claude 5 Sonnet (low effort): code 0.00 / 25.00 / 47.22 / 97.22 (spec 100.00); spec->code delta under operationalized -2.78; only agent keeping Fairness Intent in all 4 runs; 2 workspaces exclude protected attributes; COMPAS operationalized model F1 = 0. Quality: works (traceability), does not work (fairer models)
- Spec Kit + Antigravity CLI + Gemini 3.6 Flash (low effort): code 5.56 / 11.11 / 61.11 / 69.45 (spec 97.22); delta -27.78; omits FSE3 and FSE4 in all datasets; 1 operational failure (Bank Marketing, operationalized: trained on self-generated synthetic data); 2 runs training not executed by agent; Adult operationalized F1 = 0; undefined rates default to 0.0. Quality: partly (traceability), does not work (fairer models)
- Spec Kit + OpenAI Codex + GPT-5.6-Terra (low effort): code 0.00 / 5.56 / 69.45 / 80.56 (spec 94.44); delta -13.89; excludes all protected attributes in its 8 explicit/operationalized workspaces; 14 runs training not executed by agent (authors ran the script); 2 workspaces compute AAOD as signed average; only pipeline that fails on a fairness check (Bank, operationalized) still saves the model; COMPAS operationalized F1 = 0. Quality: partly (traceability), does not work (fairer models)
- Baseline (minimal prompt, all agents): code FCS 1.85; accuracy 0.857, F1 0.302

Tasks: 4 dataset tasks (binary classification). Configurations: 4 prompt levels x 3 agents (each with one model) on the same Spec Kit workflow; full factorial, 48 runs. Baseline: minimal prompt. Held constant: workflow, technical constraints (scikit-learn, save model.joblib), dataset split (stratified 80/20, hold-out isolated), low-effort reasoning mode; operator not involved. Acceptance tests: none; hold-out evaluation harness and LLM annotator. Repetitions: 1 per cell (matched blocks agent x dataset, n = 11 after excluding 1 failed block; 9 for sex, 6 for race). Human intervention: authors executed unmodified training scripts in 16 runs where the agent did not run them

Traceability: overall spec FCS 9.26 -> 20.37 -> 70.37 -> 97.22%; code FCS 1.85 -> 13.89 -> 59.26 -> 82.41%; losses in planning (-11.11) and tasks (-12.04), partial recovery in code (+8.33); quantitative FSEs survive (FSE5, FSE6 100%) vs narrative (FSE4 33.3%, FSE1 52.3%, FSE3 60.0%). Agents differ: Claude Code best under operationalized (97.22 vs 80.56 Codex, 69.45 Antigravity) but conservative under explicit. No domain differences (code 37.96-43.52%). Outcomes: accuracy 0.857/0.824/0.837/0.838 (Friedman p = 0.572); F1, precision, recall n.s.; 8 of 9 fairness measures n.s.; DI race omnibus p = 0.020 but no pairwise significant after Holm (lowest unadjusted p = 0.063, delta = 0.556); none of 27 pairwise comparisons significant. No workspace uses a fairness toolkit or mitigation; all operationalized pipelines save the model regardless of the check

Distinguished prompt levels and agents on traceability; did not distinguish model fairness or performance (low power). Repeatable: single run per cell, matched-block design; replication package. Limitations stated: binary equal-weight FCS, LLM annotator, one run per cell (non-determinism), small samples (11/9/6 blocks), prompt wording ('state', unconditional save) may drive behaviour, single framework (Spec Kit), specific agent versions, tabular binary tasks only

Specs make fairness traceable but not enforceable; agents treat fairness as post-hoc audit, deliver models regardless of thresholds and silently delegate decisions to humans. Gaps: specs need action-oriented elements (mitigation, enforcement, ownership); delegation/escalation mechanisms; auditing at artefact, implementation, release and decision levels; future: other responsible-AI principles and other SDD frameworks. Threats as in validity section
